People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with process engineering and manufacturing operations.
cond_0158.responsibilities:
Safety and Compliance: Uphold all safety and environmental standards, policies, and procedures. Foster a culture of safety and environmental responsibility.
Technical Support: Collaborate on the final design, configuration, and installation of the Melt Shop and Roaster equipment and processes.
Process Improvement: Work with Operations and Engineering teams to optimize production, reduce costs, and implement continuous improvement strategies for the Melt Shop and Roaster operations.
Data Management: Collect, measure, and analyze data using standard scientific and statistical methods. Develop and maintain comprehensive reports tracking key operational metrics.
Risk Management: Conduct thorough risk analyses of equipment, processes, and systems to preempt potential issues.
cond_0158.requirements:
2+ Years in a similar role. Experience in heavy manufacturing is an advantage.
Experience in process, technical, and analytical domains.
Proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Design of Experiment (DOE) methodologies.
Strong project management capabilities.
Adept at problem-solving and analytical thinking.
Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and familiarity with MS Project Management, Primavera, Minitab, and Thermo-Calc software.
Bachelor's degree in metallurgical engineering or chemical engineering is mandatory. Master's degree or MBA is a plus.

cond_0394.intro: We are looking for a Process Engineer to join our team. The role focuses on the Melt Shop and Roaster configurations, covering commissioning, start-up, and post start-up operations to maintain process efficiency.
cond_0394.responsibilities:
Safety and Compliance: Uphold all safety and environmental standards, policies, and procedures. Maintain a culture of safety and environmental responsibility.
Technical Support: Coordinate with relevant teams on the final design, configuration, and installation of the Melt Shop and Roaster equipment and processes.
Process Improvement: Work with Operations and Engineering teams to optimize production, reduce costs, and implement continuous improvement strategies for the Melt Shop and Roaster operations.
Data Management: Collect, measure, and analyze data using standard scientific and statistical methods. Develop and maintain comprehensive reports tracking key operational metrics.
Risk Management: Conduct thorough risk analyses of equipment, processes, and systems to identify and address potential issues.
cond_0394.requirements:
2+ Years in a similar role. Experience in heavy manufacturing is an advantage.
Experience in process, technical, and analytical domains.
Proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Design of Experiment (DOE) methodologies.
Strong project management capabilities.
Adept at problem-solving and analytical thinking.
Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and familiarity with MS Project Management, Primavera, Minitab, and Thermo-Calc software.
Bachelor's degree in metallurgical engineering or chemical engineering is mandatory. Master's degree or MBA is a plus.
cond_0394.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.
